Route Data Automation for a UK Logistics Company

An AI pipeline that updates route data across three systems in one run.

Industry
Logistics (United Kingdom)
Category
AI Automation
Workflow

The problem

The operations team spent five hours every Monday updating route data by hand across three separate systems.

What we built

An AI pipeline that pulls, processes and updates all three systems in one run, with no manual input.

How it works

The pipeline collects route data, processes it, and writes the update to all three systems together.

How the workflow runs

  1. 1

    Pull Route Data

  2. 2

    Process

  3. 3

    Update All Three Systems

Business outcomes

  • Hours of repetitive work returned to the operations team every week
  • Fewer copy-and-paste errors, and the systems always agree
  • Volume can grow without adding administrative headcount
